newsitem.title: USA: Spectrum Control names Southworth CEO.
newsitem.headline: Spectrum Control names Southworth CEO.

text.p: Spectrum Control Inc said on Monday it named Richard Southworth as its president and chief executive.
Jack Johnston, the company's previous president and chief executive, died after heart surgery on December 27.
Southworth joined Spectrum in 1991. His most recent position was general manager of the filter products group.
Spectrum makes products to protect electronic equipment against interference from random electromagnetic waves.
